docs.title: Dungeon
docs.text:
Main controller class responsible for managing dungeon generation and accessing dungeon data.

graph TD
  n1@{ shape: "circle", label: "Dungeon" }
  n1 --- n5["DungeonData"]

  n5 --- n4["DungeonCell"]

  click n5 "/dungeon/dungeon_data/" "Go to DungeonData docs"
  click n3 "/dungeon/dungeon_generator/" "Go to DungeonGenerator docs"
  click n2 "/dungeon/dungeon_node/" "Go to DungeonNode docs"
  click n4 "/dungeon/dungeon_cell/" "Go to DungeonCell docs"

docs.title: Class variables
docs.text: Variable Type Description data DungeonData Stores the generated dungeon data, including the grid and cell information.    generator DungeonGenerator Handles the procedural dungeon generation process.    width int Defines the horizontal size of the dungeon grid.    height int Defines the vertical size of the dungeon grid.

docs.title: Functions
docs.text:
func generate():
Generates a new dungeon and stores the resulting dungeon data. 
func get_cell(pos: Vector2i) -> DungeonCell:
Returns the dungeon cell at the specified position, or null if no dungeon has been generated. 
func get_neighbors(pos: Vector2i):
Returns the neighboring cells of the specified position, or an empty dictionary if no dungeon exists. 
func print_grid(mode: String, border: bool = false):
Prints a text representation of the dungeon grid using the selected display mode. 
func count_non_wall_cells() -> int:
Returns the number of non-wall cells in the generated dungeon.

docs.title: DungeonCell
docs.text: Node class representing a single dungeon grid cell. Stores possible tile resources, manages Wave Function Collapse(WFC) entropy calculation, and handles tile selection during dungeon generation.

docs.title: Class variables
docs.text: Variable Type Description collapsed bool Indicates whether the cell has already been assigned a final tile resource. collapsable_resources Array[Resource] Stores all tile resources that satisfy the current cell constraints. entropy int Represents the number of possible tile resources available for the cell. resc Resource Stores the currently assigned tile resource after the cell has collapsed. debug_log String Stores debug information generated during entropy calculation and cell collapse. position Vector2i Stores the grid coordinates of the cell. Flag Enum Defines special cell states such as starting point, boss room, border, or special rooms. flag Flag Stores the special purpose assigned to the cell.

docs.title: Functions
docs.text:
func update_entropy(neighbors: Dictionary, all_possible_resources: Array[Resource], cords: Vector2i):
Calculates valid tile resources for the cell based on neighboring cell constraints and updates the cell entropy value. 
func collapse():
Selects a tile resource from the available options using weighted randomness and permanently assigns it to the cell. 
func weighted_random(options: Array):
Selects and returns a random resource from an array based on the weight value assigned to each resource. 
func is_fully_walled():
Checks whether the assigned tile resource has walls on all four sides.

docs.title: DungeonData
docs.text: Resource class responsible for storing and managing the generated dungeon grid data.

docs.title: Class variables
docs.text: Variable Type Description width int Defines the horizontal size of the dungeon grid. height int Defines the vertical size of the dungeon grid. grid Dictionary Stores dungeon cells using their Vector2i coordinates as keys. cords_of_starting_cell Vector2i Stores the coordinates of the initial dungeon starting cell. wall_resc Resource Stores the resource reference used to identify wall cells.

docs.title: Functions
docs.text:
func print_grid(mode: String, border: bool = false):

func insert_static_cell(cell: DungeonCell, cords: Vector2i):
Inserts a predefined dungeon cell into the grid and marks it as already collapsed. 
func get_cell(cords: Vector2i) -> DungeonCell:
Returns the dungeon cell located at the specified coordinates. 
func get_neighbors(cords: Vector2i) -> Dictionary:
Returns a dictionary containing neighboring cells in the four cardinal directions. 
func grid_has_flag(flag_name) -> bool:
Checks whether any cell in the grid contains the specified flag. 
func count_non_wall_cells() -> int:
Counts and returns the number of cells that do not contain a wall resource.

docs.title: DungeonGenerator
docs.text: RefCounted class responsible for procedurally generating dungeon layouts using the Wave Function Collapse(WFC) algorithm and validating generated results.

docs.title: Class variables
docs.text: Variable Type Description dungeon_width int Defines the horizontal size of the generated dungeon. dungeon_height int Defines the vertical size of the generated dungeon. starting_cell_cords Vector2i Stores the coordinates of the dungeon starting cell. min_room_count int Defines the minimum number of non-wall cells required for a valid dungeon. max_room_count int Defines the maximum number of non-wall cells allowed for a valid dungeon. distance_to_boss int Defines the minimum required distance between the starting cell and boss room. possible_cell_rescs Array[Resource] Contains all possible tile resources that can be used during generation. cell_database Resource Stores the database containing categorized dungeon tile resources. basic_starting_cell_resc Resource Stores the default resource used for the dungeon starting cell. wall_resc Resource Stores the resource used for wall and border cells. possible_boss_rescs Array[Resource] Contains possible tile resources that can be assigned to the boss room. starting_cell DungeonCell Stores the predefined starting dungeon cell. wall_cell DungeonCell Stores the predefined wall border cell. boss_cell DungeonCell Stores the predefined boss room cell. mutex Mutex Provides thread synchronization when generating dungeons in parallel. result_dungeon DungeonData Stores the first successfully generated dungeon. threads Array[Thread] Stores the worker threads used for parallel dungeon generation.

docs.title: Functions
docs.text:
func _init(width: int, height: int, starting_cell_cords: Vector2i, starting_cell_resource: Resource, min_room_count: int, max_room_count: int, distance_to_boss: int):
Initializes the dungeon generator with generation parameters and creates predefined starting, wall, and boss cells. 
func generate() -> DungeonData:
Starts the dungeon generation process using multiple threads and returns the first valid generated dungeon. 
func generate_dungeon_thread():
Runs an independent dungeon generation attempt in a separate thread until a valid dungeon is created. 
func create_grid(data: DungeonData):
Initializes the dungeon grid, places predefined cells, and creates the outer wall border. 
func generate_dungeon(data: DungeonData):
Runs the Wave Function Collapse generation process and removes disconnected cells after generation. 
func update_entropies(data: DungeonData):
Updates the entropy values of all cells based on neighboring cells and available tile resources. 
func collapse_lowest_entropy_cell(data: DungeonData):
Finds the cell with the lowest entropy and collapses it into a selected tile resource. 
func check_dungeon(data: DungeonData) -> bool:
Validates the generated dungeon by checking room count, boss placement, and boss distance requirements. 
func load_resources(path: String):
Loads all tile resources from the specified directory and returns them as an array.
